name: MarcelloDB
tagline: Pure-C# embedded object database for Xamarin and UWP apps that stores whole object graphs.
description: MarcelloDB is an in-process NoSQL object database by Belgian developer Mark Meeus, written entirely in C# as a portable class library for Xamarin.iOS, Xamarin.Android, Windows Phone 8.1 and Windows 10 UWP. You persist plain C# objects, including nested children, lists and dictionaries, into named collections inside collection files, define typed indexes for lookups, and group writes in transactions; an encryption add-on was offered with a paid support package. Betas circulated from October 2015 and the 1.0 line stabilised soon after, but the last release, 1.0.9, shipped in February 2020. With Xamarin itself retired in favour of .NET MAUI, it is best treated as legacy.
statusNote: No commits or releases since 1.0.9 (Feb 2020), and its Xamarin/UWP targets are retired. LiteDB, Realm or SQLite are maintained options for .NET apps.

pricing.notes: MIT-licensed core; a paid Pro/support package included the encryption add-on.

strengths: Stores complete C# object graphs without ORM mapping
Pure managed code: no native binaries to ship per platform
Typed indexes and transactions in a small library
weaknesses: Unmaintained since 2020; targets retired Xamarin and UWP platforms
Querying limited to index lookups and enumeration
Encryption was only in the paid add-on
useCases: Maintaining older Xamarin or UWP apps that use it
Reference for a pure-C# embedded object store
notIdealFor: Apps needing rich queries or sync
